name: Deathknell
summary: Newly awakened Forsaken gather in Deathknell, a fortified village in a secluded valley of southwestern Tirisfal Glades. Mindless Scourge, Scarlet zealots, and dangerous beasts press the settlement as the undead claim a place in Sylvanas Windrunner’s kingdom.

sections.title: Cradle of the Forsaken
sections.body: You enter Deathknell through a narrow gorge, sealed by elite Deathguards against intruders. Newly awakened undead first open their eyes here, north of the Silverpine border and behind jagged hills. Most Tirisfal settlements kept the human names they bore under the fallen Kingdom of Lordaeron, but the undead who claimed this town gave it a new name. The old church anchors the southern grounds, where the Forsaken hold on. North of it, the village forge and surrounding streets remain overrun by mindless Scourge zombies and feral ghouls. Local caretakers bring new arrivals into the Banshee Queen’s service.

sections.title: A Valley Under Siege
sections.body: Deathknell faces danger from every side. Night Web’s Hollow, a gold mine northwest of the village, has fallen to monstrous spiders, cutting off a resource vital to the Forsaken’s fledgling economy. Southeast of town, the Scarlet Crusade keeps an encampment in the hills, watches the pass, and trades couriers with strongholds to the east while testing the valley’s defenses. Caretakers fight the mindless undead roaming the northern ruins and gather scrap metal, tools, and supplies for newly arisen souls setting out on the long road ahead.

faq.q: Why was the town renamed Deathknell?
faq.answer: The undead who claimed Deathknell renamed it after making it their settlement, unlike most Tirisfal communities, which kept their human names. Why they chose that name is unknown.

faq.q: Why is the northern half of the town overrun by undead?
faq.answer: Many corpses raised after the Third War did not regain their minds. The northern village square and forge are infested with the Mindless Ones, feral zombies, ghouls, and skeletons still driven by the Scourge’s lingering will. Forsaken defenders clear them out to salvage equipment and guard the church.

faq.q: What is the Scarlet Crusade doing near Deathknell?
faq.answer: A Scarlet Crusade detachment camps in the hills southeast of Deathknell. Its members seek to destroy all undead, watch the pass, ambush newly awakened Forsaken, and exchange scouting intelligence with Scarlet strongholds elsewhere in Lordaeron.

faq.q: Why can't the Forsaken use the local gold mine?
faq.answer: Night Web’s Hollow, in the cliffs northwest of Deathknell, is overrun by aggressive spiders. Gold matters to the Forsaken war effort, but the settlement cannot exploit the vein while the spiders remain.

angles.text: As a Forsaken adventurer, you begin here, rising from the cold earth of the Shadow Grave. Lady Sylvanas offers purpose and shelter after the horror of the Plague.
Though this valley is isolated and dark, it opens onto the Forsaken kingdom and sends fresh soldiers to strengthen the Horde’s foothold in the Eastern Kingdoms.
